name: Rance 02 Kai - Hangyaku no Shoujo-tachi -
original_name: ランス02改 反逆の少女たち
source:
Ten years ago in the town of Custom, four young girls were appointed as disciples to an old mage named Ragisis. They were to be raised as mages and work as the town's guardians after their training was completed. However, after the ten years, the girls suddenly rebelled against Ragisis and killed him. During the intense magic battle, the entire town was buried underground and a barrier spell was placed on it, preventing anyone from leaving, including the mages who terrorized the town. The four mages were soon known as Four Witches of Custom.

Having accepted a quest at the guild to help Custom, Rance sets out with Sill to defeat the four mages and save the town from their grasp.

Now that Rance is on the job, Custom is saved! ...Or is it?

[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Rance_2]AliceSoft Wiki[/url] and [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1200]MangaGamer[/url]]

This is a remake of the original Rance II with a completely rewritten script, new art and some gameplay changes.

Note: Alice 2010 contains two different versions of Rance II: Rance 02 and Rance 02 Kai. This entry is for Rance 02 Kai that has a completely rewritten script, not Rance 02 that uses the old script with the new art.
translation:
十年前，在风俗镇，四名年轻女孩被一位名叫拉吉西斯的老法师收为弟子。他们将被培养为法师，并在完成训练后担任城镇的守护者。然而十年后，女孩们突然反抗拉吉西斯并杀死了他。在激烈的魔法战斗中，整个城镇被埋入地下，并在其上放置了结界咒语，阻止任何人离开，包括那些恐吓城镇的法师。这四位法师很快被称为风俗四女巫。

兰斯接受了公会帮助海关的任务，与希尔一起出发，击败四名法师，并从他们手中拯救小镇。

现在兰斯开始工作了，定制就得救了！…或者是吗？

[编辑自[url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Rance_2]AliceSoft Wiki[/url] 和 [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1200]MangaGamer[/url]]

这是原版《兰斯II》的重制版，具有完全重写的脚本、新的美术和一些游戏玩法更改。

注意：Alice 2010包含Rance II的两个不同版本：Rance 02和Rance 02 Kai。此条目适用于完全重写脚本的《Rance 02 Kai》，而不是使用旧脚本和新艺术的《Rance 02》。
